capabilities: Copy the entire vault to a target folder as timestamped snapshots
Schedule backups on startup, hourly, or daily with retries
Prune old snapshots with a daily/weekly/monthly retention policy
Exclude named files and folders from backup runs
Show live progress and log only errors to backup-errors.log
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux), will not load on mobile. Target directory must be outside the vault or in a hidden dot-folder. Makes no network requests and has no telemetry; releases carry build-provenance attestations.
motivation: The author found existing backup/sync plugins centered on cloud services, conflict resolution, or partial sync, and wanted a plain timestamped local safety net for people who already sync their vault another way.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make scheduled, versioned full-vault copies to a local or network folder without relying on cloud sync services.
summary: Backup tool that copies the entire vault to a chosen folder as timestamped snapshots on a schedule, pruning old copies by a retention policy.
